findings.correction: Added a regression that first demonstrated acceptance of the invalid pair, then constrained both request and response schemas to exactly Chat-to-Codex or Codex-to-Chat.

findings.description: The first fresh review found that individually valid Local Delta fields could form contradictory baseline states or aggregate relevance claims.

findings.description: The first fresh review found that duplicate request identities silently overwrote one another during response-link validation.
